title: Grateful Dead Live at Texas Christian University on 1971-11-14
lineage: SBD -> Master Reel (10 inch) -> CD -> Sonic Solutions -> CD -> EAC -> SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1971 TCU show, highlighted by a smoking Other One suite, cosmic Mexicali lead and tight Sugar Magnolia.
ai_review.review: The November‑14‑1971 Texas Christian University concert is praised for its razor‑sharp SBD mix and the band’s ferocious performance. Reviewers repeatedly cite the explosive Other One > Me & My Uncle > Other One sequence, Jerry’s soaring Mexicali lead, and a tight Sugar Magnolia as standout moments, while noting the overall high‑octane energy throughout both sets.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews (≈90%) are 4–5 stars, emphasizing superb musical performance and excellent soundboard quality; only a few minor complaints about older muffled versions exist.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix with balanced instruments and vocals; reviewers note the recording is “very good”, “crisp”, and “well mixed”. A single comment mentioned an older muffled version, but this SBD is consistently praised for clarity.

standout_songs: The Other One > Me & My Uncle > The Other One
Beat It On Down the Line
show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers love the song order and transitions, calling them “mind‑blowing” and noting a solid, logical progression that keeps the momentum high across both sets.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his youthful tone, cosmic lead on Mexicali, clean guitar/vocals, and overall tight playing.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for “thumping hard”, machine‑gun bass runs, strong vocal presence, and driving the Other One suite.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith is noted as “holding on for dear life” yet adding intensity; his playing is described as fresh and energetic.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill’s (or Mickey’s) drumming is generally well‑balanced; one reviewer suggested cymbals could be a tad louder, but overall the rhythm section is solid.
